name: Chess.com Published-Data API (PubAPI)
tier_rationale: Chess.com, LLC, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a documented public API (A8 trusted); P116 FC9.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

pubapi_player.title: Chess.com PubAPI player profile (api.chess.com/pub/player/{username})

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

pubapi_player.notes: Research C0264: 404 JSON = ABSENT; serial requests are unlimited, parallel requests get 429 (documented): concurrency 1 (P116 FC5). twitch_url and streaming channels are linked accounts (expand=False).

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P116 chesscom_player). Serial requests only (FC5).
